### Base policies in this task's domain

- `cni_billing_correction` clauses in force (24-month lookback with end-of-month rule; one correction per line; $500.00 agent limit, larger corrections not posted and handed to a human with the not-covered reason; tag revisions and interval corrections not billing errors) → rebill_credit_lookback_and_authority and billing_correction_limits: equivalent.
- `cni_market_notices` clauses in force (notices kept; fixed price changes only for change in law, only where allowed, only with a notice at least 30 days ahead; capacity/transmission changes are not pass-throughs) → market_notices_and_passthroughs, change_in_law_passthrough_terms: equivalent.
- `cni_energy_billing` remaining clauses (billable statuses; fixed; RTI; B&I index balance with no adder and whole block billed when below; holdover adder and waiver; index month; rounding) → energy_line_pricing clauses 1–7: equivalent.
- `cni_etf`, `cni_termination`, `cni_security_deposit`, `cni_agg_deposit_cap`: as in task 0's file.

### Prerequisites listed separately

1. review ← fixed-price rebill. Sentence verbatim only in anniversary_security_review (state form). Resolution basis: fixed_price_line_correction ("returns what the fixed-price energy line of the pass-through cycle, which is its block energy charge line on a block and index contract …, was billed above the price in force for that cycle"), the price-in-force and fixed-price-kWh documents, and records (pass-through notice 2026-06-12 → 2026-07-01, July block line at 6.62, no credit naming it). Same strength.
2. review ← index rebill. Sentence verbatim only in the review hub. Resolution basis: index_line_correction ("billed above the index price the contract allows"), the index-adder and index-kWh documents, records (July index line at 5.97 vs 5.12 notice). Same strength.
3. review ← exit damages. Sentence verbatim only in the review hub. Resolution basis: contract_exit_damages scope ("closed during its term because another supplier enrolled the facility or the utility final-billed it") and records (Joliet closed final_billed 2026-08-14 before 2027-11-30, no fee line). Same strength.
- None of the three depended-on policies' documents mentions the review. Authoring fields have no home.

## bijection_verdict

**PASS.** All atoms of the four extended policies (rules, baselines, every tier of every declared factor, three prerequisites, tool contracts) and of the governing base clauses have equivalent homes; every declared overwrite is carried as retired with the untouched parts of the same clause kept in force; no undeclared retirement.

Policy-side notes (do not change this verdict):
- PS-1 (task 0's PS-2 applies here too). The combined-deposit ceiling of `cni_agg_deposit_cap` stays in force in the source and the KB, while the review compute applies no ceiling. Untriggered (held 12,187.50 + 706.25).
- PS-4. Base `cni_market_notices` clause 2 in force ("only with a regulatory pass-through notice issued at least the structure's regulatory change notice days … before its effective date") sits beside the price-in-force factor, which prices a short-noticed pass-through day-weighted rather than refusing it. With the "later of" clause retired, the source no longer states which cycles after the pass-through cycle take the new price when the notice was short; in this world the August and September block lines (cycles beginning after the notice-period day) are not reachable by any correction policy and are not part of the scored solution, so no visible answer changes. The KB renders both clauses as the source has them.
